A work 
 order must be issued, the 
 qualified test group should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

items: Isolate the transformer out of service
Disconnect the transformer from bridles
Connect the bridles to earth.
All bushings should be clean otherwise errors reading could be happened.

Make short circuit S.C LV side bushings, H.V side bushing and Teriery side
 bushing.
Connect the earth of the TR. To earth point of the tester.
Hazards could be happened.

Test equipment type 
M4K, Doble
Place (UST -GST) switch at L - GUARD
Connect HV cable to SC HV bushing.
Connect LV cable to SC LV bushing.

Turn on to C position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.

Changeover the switch to OF position and select 
 the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.

Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment testing procedure checklist, 
 which must be performed for Power Transformers according to each manufacturer
 Instructions.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 order must be issued, the 
 qualified test group should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Isolate the transformer out of service
Disconnect the transformer from bridles
Connect the bridles to earth.
All bushings should be clean otherwise errors reading could be happened.
Make short circuit S.C LV side bushings, H.V side bushing and Teriery side
 bushing.
Connect the earth of the TR. To earth point of the tester.
Hazards could be happened.
Test equipment type 
M4K, Doble
Test equipment type 
M4K, Doble
Work to be Carried Out
Test # 1 
(CH) HV ---- E + (LV + Ter. guard)
Place (UST -GST) switch at L - GUARD
Connect HV cable to SC HV bushing.
Connect LV cable to SC LV bushing.
Turn on to C position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
Changeover the switch to OF position and select 
 the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
Test # 2 ( CL) 
LV ---------- E + (HV+Ter. guard)
1.
Place (UST -GST) switch at H-Guard.
2. Connect S.C HV cable to S.C HV bushing.
3. 
Connect S.C LV cable to S.C.LV bushing.
4. 
Short HV bushing to tertiary.
5. 
 Turn on to C position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
6. 
 Changeover the switch to OF position and 
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
7. 
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
8. 
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
Test # 3 
(CHL) HV ---------- LV +(T +E guard)
Place (UST -GST ) switch at UST.
Connect HV cable to S.C HV bushing.
Connect LV cable to S.C.LV bushing.
Ground the 
 Tertiary 
 winding.
Turn on to "C" position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
Changeover the switch to "OF" position and 
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
Test # 4 
(CHTer) HV--------- Ter+ (LV +E) guard
Place (UST -GST ) switch at UST.
Connect HV cable 
 to S.C of HV bushing.
Connect LV cable for S.C of Ter bushing.
Graund the L.V winding.
Turn on to "C" position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
Changeover the switch to "OF" position and 
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
Test # 5 
(CLTer ) LV ---------- Ter (HV +E)
guard
Place (UST -GST ) switch at UST.
Connect HV cable to S.C of LV bushing.
Connect LV cable to S.C of 
 Tertiary 
 bushing.
Ground the H.V winding.
Turn on to "C" position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
Changeover the switch to "OF" position and 
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
Test # 6 
(CTer ) T
---------- E+ (HV +LV) guard
Place (UST -GST ) switch at ( L-Guard)..
Connect HV cable to S.C of Teriory bushing.
Connect LV cable to S.C of LV bushing.
Short H.V bushing to L.V bushing.
Turn on to "C" position and dial switch of the 
 tester to get balance of the pointer.
Changeover the switch to "OF" position and 
 select the range and dial to get balance of pointer.
Record the results on the attached test sheet.
Correct the reading to be at 20oC.
